embeddingModalContent:
📚 Contextual training without fine-tuning
Text embeddings allow you to add specific information to the model's context without lengthy retraining.

🔍 Embedding applications:
- Upload instructions → model uses them in responses
- Upload FAQ → model searches for answers in uploaded context
- Upload documentation → model quotes and references it

💡 Advantages:
- Fast loading (no training required)
- Easy to update information
- Can be used for different models
- Safe (original text stored separately)

⚙️ Technical details:
- Each document is converted to a vector representation (embedding)
- When processing a query, the model finds relevant fragments
- Model uses found context to formulate response

📊 Usage recommendations:
- One document = one logically complete fragment
- Up to 65,000 characters per document
- Use clear names for searching
esperoChannelSettingsDesc: Configuration of model interaction parameters with various communication channels
esperoIgnoreLabel: Ignore questions until agent sends response
esperoWaitTitle: "Wait for question seconds" - the model will wait for the user's next question before responding.
esperoWaitExample:
For example, with a 4 second wait:
	User - "Hello"
	User - "My name is John!"
	User - "How are you?"
Agent's response will be:
	Agent - "Nice to meet you John, my name is Marusia. I'm doing great!"
If there was no wait, the Agent would respond immediately:
	User - "Hello"
	Agent - "Hello, I'm Marusia!"
esperoLimitTitle: "Character limit in question" - limit on the number of characters in user's question.
esperoLimitExample:
Default limit is 1024 characters
If a message exceeds 1024 characters, the agent will ignore it
esperoLimitWarning: Remember that most communication channels have a character limit per message. If the limit is exceeded, the message will not be delivered!
esperoLimitChannels:
Limits for different channels:
	Instagram - 2200
	Facebook - 3000 ('part of message will be hidden if exceeded')
	Telegram - 4096"
	WhatsApp - 4096"
esperoIgnoreTitle: "Ignore questions until agent sends response" - skip additional user questions before Agent's response.
esperoIgnoreExample:
- parameter "yes" - Agent ignores additional user questions"
Example:
	User - "Hello"
	Agent is preparing response to user's question...
	User asks another question before getting response - "My name is John!"
Agent's response will be:
	Agent - "Hello! My name is Marusia"

- parameter "no" - Agent listens to additional user questions"
Example:
	User - "Hello"
	Agent is preparing response to user's question...
	User asks another question before getting response - "My name is John!"
Agent's response will be:
	Agent - "Hello!"
	Agent - "Nice to meet you John!"

uploadFilesModalWhatIsTitle: Why do you need model training?
uploadFilesModalWhatIsText:
Uploading files to the Agent serves a very practical purpose — it allows you to enrich the conversation with specific, verified information from your documents. Here's why this might be needed:
📚 Context from your data
Files allow you to navigate not only general knowledge, but also the specifics of your content — whether it's a PDF with technical documentation, Markdown with instructions, or a text export from a database.
🔍 Search and analysis
Will allow the Agent to:
- Extract key information from long files
- Answer questions like "what does the document say about this"
- Generate summaries or highlight key points
- Compare the contents of multiple files if you upload them
💡 Automation and acceleration
By uploading files, you save time on explanations. Instead of copying and pasting text manually, you simply upload the file, and the Agent understands how to work with it.
🤖 Application examples
- Uploaded a .docx with a report → Agent makes a brief summary and references it in responses
- Provided a .py script → Agent analyzes what the code does and answers questions about it
- Provided a .json configuration file → Agent uses these parameters in its reasoning
uploadFilesModalFormatsText:
📄 Documents and text files
- .txt — plain text
- .md — Markdown

💻 Code and scripts
- .py — Python

- .rb — Ruby
- .php — PHP

🧠 Data formats

s3ModalWhatIsContent:
S3 storage is a personal cloud file storage that allows the agent model to access your documents and send them based on user requests. This is a powerful tool for working with files in dialogue.
☁️ Main capabilities of S3 storage:
- Secure storage of your files in the cloud
- Automatic file sending on user request
- Support for various document formats
📤 How the model uses S3 storage:
When a user requests a specific file, the model can:
- Find the required file in your S3 storage
- Automatically send the file
- Provide file information (size, modification date)
- Suggest alternative files if there is no exact match
s3ModalExamplesContent:
📋 Automatic document sending:
User: "Send me the latest sales report"
→ Model will find the file "sales_report_march2026.pdf" and send the document
📊 Working with presentations:
User: "Need a presentation about the new product"
→ Model will find "product_presentation_2026.pptx" and provide access
📄 Sending instructions:
User: "How to set up the system?"
→ Model will send "setup_instructions.pdf" from your storage
📈 Analytical data:
User: "Show data for the quarter"
→ Model will find the corresponding Excel file and send it
s3ModalAdvantagesContent:
✅ File automation:
- No need to search for files manually
- Model will find and send the required document itself
- Time saved on sending files
- Smart search by file names
🔒 Security and control:
- Files are accessible only to you and your model
- Secure cloud storage
- Storage size control
- Ability to delete unnecessary files
🚀 Improved user experience:
- Fast document sending on request
- Automatic suggestion of relevant files
- Integration with model dialogue
- Support for various file formats
s3ModalWhenContent:
✅ Enable S3 storage if:
- You need to automatically send files to users
- You have frequently requested documents
- You want to automate file operations
- You need to provide access to reports and presentations
- You work with a knowledge base and documentation
❌ You can skip if:
- You don't plan to send files through the model
- You only work with text responses
- You have no files to store
⚠️ Important to remember:
S3 storage has volume limitations. Monitor space usage and delete unnecessary files for optimal operation.

crmModalWhatIsContent:
CRM (Customer Relationship Management) is a customer relationship management system. Integration allows:
• Automatically create contacts from dialogues
• Save communication history
